name: Tatoeba example sentences
goodFor: Crowd-sourced translated example sentences in hundreds of languages.

evidence.quote: Tatoeba's technical infrastructure uses the default Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France license (CC-BY 2.0 FR) for the use of textual sentences.
Tatoeba allows licensing each text sentence, and applying the same license for all the audio contributions of the same contributor.
We are not generally opposed to using our content for commercial purposes. However, this choice depends primarily on contributors.
Certain phrases, in particular audio, may be contributed with a non-marketing condition, and therefore must not be marketed.
Exceptionally, audio sentences may be under other licenses than Creative Commons

notes: Checked against the Terms of Use (in force since 24 April 2022; the French version prevails). The default licence for text sentences is CC BY 2.0 FR, but a licence is set for each sentence (CC0 and CC BY are the examples given; ShareAlike and NoDerivatives conditions are possible), commercial use "depends primarily on contributors", some phrases, mostly audio, carry a non-commercial condition, and some audio isn't under Creative Commons at all. Because the licence is per sentence, it is link only; a sentence could be shown only after its own licence is read. The terms ban automated use that overloads the site; bulk data is offered from the downloads host (downloads.tatoeba.org, not reached). User-contributed, and the terms say translations and audio aren't checked by professionals.
